name: @now-playing/discovery-demo-web
description: Airwave Discovery demo: the browser half. Not a pnpm workspace member: it builds with the toolchain hoisted at the repo root (react 19.2.8, vite 8.2.2, typescript 6.0.3, vitest 5.0.0, locked by the root pnpm-lock.yaml) and reads packages/aqua-ui from source. The Python sidecar in ../server serves the built app.
